title: PatchTray App Settings
description: User settings document stored at %APPDATA%/io.patchtray.desktop/settings.json. Validated by the Rust backend before save; this schema is for editor tooling and documentation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation (optional at runtime; written by the app on save).

selected_device.description: Last selected ASIO driver name. Empty string means none selected.

plugin_directories.description: VST3 scan directories. Empty list is normalized to the default Windows VST3 path on load/save.

items.description: Absolute or rooted filesystem path to a VST3 directory.

setup.description: First-run setup wizard gate. Optional; missing key is migrated to completed=true when the settings file already exists.

tutorial.description: Interactive tutorial state. Optional; missing key → keeps defaults (completed: false).

active_preset.description: Last selected/saved preset name. Free tier may only use this single preset when multiple files exist.

ui_scale.description: UI scale percent applied via webview zoom (settings slider uses step 5).

start_with_windows.description: Launch PatchTray automatically when Windows starts.

minimize_to_system_tray.description: Close button hides the main window to the system tray instead of exiting.

hardware_acceleration.description: Use GPU rendering for the node graph and cable animations.

completed.description: True after the first-run setup wizard is finished or skipped. Cold install defaults to false; existing files without this key migrate to true on load.

completed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when setup finished or was skipped.

skipped.description: True if the user skipped the wizard (or skip-all) rather than completing every step.

completed.description: True after the tutorial is completed or skipped.

completed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the tutorial was finished or skipped.

skipped.description: True if the user skipped the tutorial.

current_step.description: 0 = not in progress; 1-5 = last active step
